text: Hormesis is defined as a phenomenon. <break time="0.8s" /> In which a harmful substance gives stimulating and beneficial effects. <break time="0.8s" /> To living organisms. <break time="0.8s" /> When the quantity of the harmful substance is small. <break time="0.8s" /> Exercise is the easiest example of how hormesis works. <break time="0.8s" /> Lets say. <break time="0.8s" /> You have been sedentary for 10 years. <break time="0.8s" /> And you hear about the benefits of CrossFit. <break time="0.8s" /> CrossFit is a 60 minute, high intensity workout. <break time="0.8s" /> Often involving Olympic lifts, burst training. <break time="0.8s" /> And other functional modalities. <break time="0.8s" /> If you decide. <break time="0.8s" /> That your first workout back into the world of fitness. <break time="0.8s" /> Will be a CrossFit one. <break time="0.8s" /> Your body will have a hard time. <break time="0.8s" /> Adapting to this stress. <break time="0.8s" /> You will be sore for days. <break time="0.8s" /> And you may even hurt yourself. <break time="0.8s" /> You would have done too much. <break time="0.8s" /> And fallen out of your hormetic zone. <break time="0.8s" /> However if you instead did a 45 minute walk. <break time="0.8s" /> And some push ups, squats, and planks. <break time="0.8s" /> Your body most likely could adapt. <break time="0.8s" /> To this light stress. <break time="0.8s" /> You would stay within your hormetic zone. <break time="0.8s" /> And you would grow stronger and healthier. <break time="0.8s" /> You would have found your sweet spot. <break time="0.8s" /> Over time. <break time="0.8s" /> The goal is to create a higher hormetic ceiling. <break time="0.8s" /> So you can apply more stressors. <break time="0.8s" /> And stay within the zone of benefits.
